newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers steady, seen firm in January.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers steady, seen firm in January.

text.p: Bunker prices in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp region were steady to firmer for January loading but prompt prices were still weighed down by a local refinery problem, traders said.
Bunkers traded at $116 a tonne delivered, and dealers in the region said continued fall-out from a problem at a flexi-coker at Esso's refinery in Antwerp kept prompt barge prices weak.
January was worth some $3 or $4 over those in December.
Hamburg prices were stable at around $118/$119, while those at Algeciras were boosted to around $126 ex-wharf by recent delays in the port.
But activity in most international ports was fairly lacklustre and dealers said the end-of-year holidays had dampened activity.
